propositions: BindingRepository lifecycle alerts are documented as deduped but the 24-hour suppression window never fires because alert records lack timestamp_ns field

alert_store.is_deduped computes ts from rec.get('timestamp_ns', 0) and tests if now - ts <= window_ns, but records built by BindingRepository.alert() contain no timestamp_ns so ts defaults to 0 and the window check always returns False

Each pass over a corrupt bindings-retired.json appends a duplicate binding-retired-file-corrupt record indefinitely because dedup suppression never fires, causing unbounded local growth in the append-only alerts JSONL

The fix assigns central ownership of timestamp_ns to alert_store.append() which now stamps records when the field is absent, allowing caller-supplied values to win so existing stampers remain unchanged
Dedup suppression now fires for same-key alerts within 24 hours while still permitting alerts outside the window and remaining backward-compatible with pre-existing records lacking the field
